responsibility: This file implements D-specific handling of GCC attributes as they appear through the D frontend, covering both user-visible `gcc.attributes` UDAs and internal attribute setup for built-in functions. It defines the D language attribute tables, mutual-exclusion rules, and per-attribute handlers that validate where an attribute may be applied, diagnose bad arguments, and translate accepted attributes into GCC DECL/TYPE attribute state such as visibility, section placement, calling or optimization properties, nonnull/no_sanitize metadata, SIMD/OpenMP markings, and register binding.
